questions.text: Is there a formal, executive-sponsored information security program with a named owner?
Are security policies reviewed and approved at least annually?
Do you hold a current SOC 2 Type II or ISO/IEC 27001 certification?
Is MFA enforced for all remote and administrative access?
Is access granted on a least-privilege basis and reviewed periodically?
Is customer data encrypted at rest and in transit with modern algorithms?
Is data segregated logically or physically between tenants/customers?
Do you perform regular vulnerability scanning and remediate to a defined SLA?
Is an independent penetration test conducted at least annually?
Do you have a documented incident response plan with defined breach-notification timelines?
Will you notify customers of a security incident affecting their data within a contractual timeframe?
Are backups performed, tested, and are RTO/RPO objectives defined?
Do you assess and monitor the security of your own subprocessors/vendors?
Is security awareness training mandatory for all staff at least annually?
